Memory
The SD650-N V3 uses Lenovo TruDDR5 memory. When confgi ured with 5th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable
processors, the memory operates at up to 5600 MHz. When confgi ured with 4th Gen processors, the
memory operates at up to 4800 MHz. The server supports 16 DIMMs with 2 processors. The processors
have 8 memory channels and support 1 DIMM per channel. The server supports up to 2TB of memory using
16x 128GB 3DS RDIMMs and two processors.
Lenovo TruDDR5 memory uses the highest quality components that are sourced from Tier 1 DRAM suppliers
and only memory that meets the strict requirements of Lenovo is selected. It is compatibility tested and
tuned to maximize performance and reliability. From a service and support standpoint, Lenovo TruDDR5
memory automatically assumes the system warranty, and Lenovo provides service and support worldwide.
